1.21.1.1.2.2: Other mods' diesel, gasoline, kerosene, biodiesel, ethanol and LPG burn in the combustion engine, each with its own power and burn time.
1.21.1.1.2.1: EMI support: every BuildCraft recipe in EMI, recipe filling and item dragging. JEI and EMI can fill the recipe packager's pattern, and dragging into it from JEI works now.
1.21.1.1.2.0: BuildCraft 7.1's crafting by package: the recipe packager, the stamping table and packages. A logo in the mods list.
1.21.1.1.1.2: Oil and fuel work with other mods through the common fluid tags c:oil, c:crude_oil, c:fuel and c:light_fuel. Links, update checks and a new description in the mods list.
1.21.1.1.1.1: Fixes pickaxes: with the mod installed, stone and ores mined slowly and dropped nothing.
1.21.1.1.1.0: BuildCraft 7.1's robots: 17 redstone boards, docking stations, the programming and charging tables, the requester and the construction mark.
1.21.1.1.0.0-rc.1: First release candidate: everything BuildCraft 8.0 had for Minecraft 1.12.2.
